messages:

Cc: finance@smallmetric.co
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot onboarding without PO (SmallMetric)

Hi Olga —

Thanks for taking a look. We’re SmallMetric, a two-person analytics SaaS doing a short pilot with one of our customers. Procurement asks vendors to issue a PO before work starts, but we don’t have a PO system on our side (we invoice).

Can Redwood support a short-term onboarding without an active PO? We’re asking for an exception just for the 6-week pilot (~$4,200 total). I attached a bank verification letter and our W-9 to speed vendor setup.

Docs attached: smallmetric-bank-letter.pdf, smallmetric-w9.pdf

If a formal exception isn’t possible, can you advise the fastest path to get a PO issued from your side (we can accept invoice-only terms).

Appreciate any flexibility — we’d like to start next week.

Thanks,
Kate
Finance & Ops, SmallMetric
kate@smallmetric.co

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Summers <kate@smallmetric.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot onboarding without PO (SmallMetric)

Hi Kate —

Thanks for the attachments and the clear ask. Short answer: we do have a limited exception path for small pilots, but it requires a short checklist and finance approval. To avoid back-and-forth, here’s our proposed SME exemption playbook: 

- Eligibility: vendor annual ARR < $500k or single-engagement <= $10k.
- Term: one-time pilot exemption up to $10k, duration <= 90 days.
- Evidence: W-9, bank verification, company website link, and a PO waiver request email signed by vendor contact.
- Controls: transaction must be coded to a temporary GL tag and flagged for auditing; no auto-renew; accounts payable to process net-30 invoices.

If you meet the above, I’ll route to Finance for sign-off (Marcus). I’ve cc’d Marissa to coordinate onboarding tasks (vendor profile, MSA addendum).

Next steps for you: confirm the expected pilot total and timeline, and attach the company website URL. I’ll prepare the internal exception memo once finance confirms.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Olga — and thanks for the clear checklist, Kate. Finance is open to a controlled exception provided we capture the right controls. My proposal (for internal sign-off):

1) Cap: single invoice cap of $10,000 for the pilot. Any spend above that requires a standard PO.
2) Payment terms: net-30, standard invoice submission to AP (ap@redwood.ai).
3) Accounting controls: tag spend with GL temporary code 71-TEST-POEX; create an audit note (RD-1429) referencing the exception approval.
4) Contract: vendor must sign a one-page payment addendum confirming no auto-renew and scope limited to the pilot dates.
5) One-time setup fee: none.

If Olga approves, I’ll route a short exception memo to the Procurement Review Board and we’ll get AP to provision the vendor record. Note: we will not accept recurring billing under the exemption.

Marcus
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
